segments.leave_state: extrusions sorted and labelled A–E, all end faces deburred, 16 M5×16 BHCS started finger-loose in eight A extrusions, and one blind joint dry-run understood. Writes the four diagonals and the final torque into the frame log.
segments.text: Step 01.20 → Step 01.22 · ~25 min · leave-state: final squareness pass done, backers confirmed still bagged for Ch 05, and the frame log table complete. Work through Checkpoint 01, then the frame can come off the counter.

rows.label: Ch 02 — Z drives, Z idlers, Z rails, deck

segments.leave_state: printed parts sorted into `a` and `b` piles and inspected, the iron temperature confirmed on the coupon, and all 36 heat-set inserts seated in the four retainers and four drive mains. Unplug the iron. Nothing is assembled.
helpers: Sorts the printed parts into the a and b piles and counts them.
Writes Z0 to Z3 on four tape flags and sticks one per corner.
segments.text: Step 02.01 → Step 02.04 · ~40 min · leave-state: printed parts sorted into `a` and `b` piles and inspected, the iron temperature confirmed on the coupon, and all 36 heat-set inserts seated in the four retainers and four drive mains. Unplug the iron. Nothing is assembled.

segments.leave_state: the first Z rail is centred, tightened centre-outward, verified smooth over full travel, and its carriage is taped. A rail is a self-contained unit; stop only with one finished, never with half its screws started.
helpers: Runs each carriage end to end over the bench and says smooth or notchy.
segments.text: Step 02.05 → Step 02.08 · ~25 min · leave-state: the first Z rail is centred, tightened centre-outward, verified smooth over full travel, and its carriage is taped. A rail is a self-contained unit; stop only with one finished, never with half its screws started.

segments.leave_state: all four Z rails are on, facing each other, sharing the same ~3 mm bottom gap and hole pattern, every carriage taped or stoppered. The frame is still the right way up. Do not turn it over until the carriages are secured.
helpers: Tape-marks holes 2, 4 and on to 18 on each rail before its screws go in.
segments.text: Step 02.09 → Step 02.10 · ~35 min · leave-state: all four Z rails are on, facing each other, sharing the same ~3 mm bottom gap and hole pattern, every carriage taped or stoppered. The frame is still the right way up. Do not turn it over until the carriages are secured.

segments.leave_state: the printer is inverted and stable, the deck panel is in with its notch to the back and captured by eight support clips of the measured thickness, the four M5 T-nuts sit under the deck holes, and the FRONT tape is on. Leave the deck unbolted: those four bolts belong to Ch 09 Step 09.5.
helpers: Takes the other side of the frame as it turns over, then counts the four T-nuts in.
Reads the caliper display aloud three times so you can pick the clip.
Holds the far edge of the deck panel level as it lowers into the frame.
Writes FRONT on the tape strip and sticks it on the front bottom rail.
segments.text: Step 02.11 → Step 02.16 · ~30 min · leave-state: the printer is inverted and stable, the deck panel is in with its notch to the back and captured by eight support clips of the measured thickness, the four M5 T-nuts sit under the deck holes, and the FRONT tape is on. Leave the deck unbolted: those four bolts belong to Ch 09 Step 09.5.

segments.leave_state: four complete shaft assemblies: 20T pulleys at 33 mm, bearing and precision-spacer stacks built, 80T pulleys threadlocked, and the 188 mm belt loops hung on. The bearings are only slid onto the shaft here, so nothing is mid-assembly. Do not start Step 02.22 until you can close a drive in one sitting.
helpers: Reads the caliper aloud: 33 mm from the long shaft end to the pulley.
Reads the caliper aloud on each of the four shafts: 33 mm.
segments.text: Step 02.17 → Step 02.21 · ~35 min · leave-state: four complete shaft assemblies: 20T pulleys at 33 mm, bearing and precision-spacer stacks built, 80T pulleys threadlocked, and the 188 mm belt loops hung on. The bearings are only slid onto the shaft here, so nothing is mid-assembly. Do not start Step 02.22 until you can close a drive in one sitting.

segments.leave_state: all four drives closed: shafts seated, retainers down on six M3×40 each, blue baseplates on with their captive M5 nuts, belt loops captive and free. Each drive is one ~9-minute unit, so if you stop earlier, stop with a drive fully closed and its baseplate on — never with a drive half-closed.
helpers: Holds the drive beside the page and names any difference from the section view.
segments.text: Step 02.22 → Step 02.26 · ~35 min · leave-state: all four drives closed: shafts seated, retainers down on six M3×40 each, blue baseplates on with their captive M5 nuts, belt loops captive and free. Each drive is one ~9-minute unit, so if you stop earlier, stop with a drive fully closed and its baseplate on — never with a drive half-closed.

segments.leave_state: four Z motors carry their 16T pulleys at 10.7 mm and are bolted to their `a`/`b` mounts with the cable exits matched. Get every remaining 16T pulley off the bench before you walk away, and leave the motor cables labelled.
helpers: Counts each pulley's teeth to 16 and reads the 10.7 mm caliper aloud.
segments.text: Step 02.27 → Step 02.28 · ~25 min · leave-state: four Z motors carry their 16T pulleys at 10.7 mm and are bolted to their `a`/`b` mounts with the cable exits matched. Get every remaining 16T pulley off the bench before you walk away, and leave the motor cables labelled.

segments.leave_state: the Z0 corner is complete: drive body on its two M5×40, motor slid in, cam closed, both M5×10 tight, rubber foot on, and the p.46 section check passed. One corner is a self-contained unit and this is the natural stop.

segments.text: Step 02.29 → Step 02.37 · ~30 min · leave-state: the Z0 corner is complete: drive body on its two M5×40, motor slid in, cam closed, both M5×10 tight, rubber foot on, and the p.46 section check passed. One corner is a self-contained unit and this is the natural stop.

segments.leave_state: four idler cages assembled with their captive M3 nuts and 20T idlers on M5×30 axles, tensioner screws left deliberately short of tight. Nothing is mounted to the frame yet.
helpers: Writes Z0 to Z3 on the motor cable labels by physical corner.
segments.text: Step 02.38 → Step 02.40 · ~20 min · leave-state: four idler cages assembled with their captive M3 nuts and 20T idlers on M5×30 axles, tensioner screws left deliberately short of tight. Nothing is mounted to the frame yet.

segments.leave_state: all four Z idlers mounted, each aligned with the drive below it, all eight M5×30 tight, printer back upright on its feet. Work through Checkpoint 02 before the gantry starts hiding this.
helpers: Sights down both pulleys and says if the belt line twists.
Ticks the checkpoint list while you point at each item on the machine.
segments.text: Step 02.41 → Step 02.44 · ~25 min · leave-state: all four Z idlers mounted, each aligned with the drive below it, all eight M5×30 tight, printer back upright on its feet. Work through Checkpoint 02 before the gantry starts hiding this.

segments.leave_state: the plate is unpacked and identified top from bottom, the film is off, and the pre-applied heater, thermal fuse and PE screw are all inspected and left alone. helpers: Points to the magnet side and the heater side and names each one.
Counts the pad screws aloud and points out any lifted corner.
segments.text: Step 03.1 → Step 03.6 · ~30 min · leave-state: the plate is unpacked and identified top from bottom, the film is off, and the pre-applied heater, thermal fuse and PE screw are all inspected and left alone. segments.leave_state: the top face is cleaned, the magnet is rolled down bubble-free and all four bolt holes are cut clear through it and test-fitted with an M3×20 and a hex key. The lamination is finished, so nothing is mid-adhesive. Lay the plate flat, magnet up, and cover it.
helpers: Holds a torch behind the straightedge and says if any light shows under it.
Holds the plate flat on the towel and checks afterwards for missed patches.
segments.text: Step 03.7 → Step 03.10 · ~30 min · leave-state: the top face is cleaned, the magnet is rolled down bubble-free and all four bolt holes are cut clear through it and test-fitted with an M3×20 and a hex key. The lamination is finished, so nothing is mid-adhesive. Lay the plate flat, magnet up, and cover it.

segments.leave_state: the plate is on its four thumb-nut spacers, set 38 mm behind the frame's front edge and centred, one bolt tight and three deliberately loose, cables loose above the deck. This is the natural stop: the plate is bolted and the assembly is stable. Do not tighten the other three bolts.
helpers: Holds the rule on one inner face and reads the gap at each end.
Holds the three leads toward the left extrusion while you lower the plate.
Reads the rule at each corner and calls the number back to you.
segments.text: Step 03.11 → Step 03.17 · ~35 min · leave-state: the plate is on its four thumb-nut spacers, set 38 mm behind the frame's front edge and centred, one bolt tight and three deliberately loose, cables loose above the deck. This is the natural stop: the plate is bolted and the assembly is stable. Do not tighten the other three bolts.

segments.leave_state: the four-corner gap check is done, the plate's leads are dressed loose above the deck with nothing tied or terminated, and the flex plate has been test-fitted, removed and the bed covered with cardboard. Work through Checkpoint 03; the cover stays on for the next six chapters.
helpers: Reads the caliper at each corner and writes the four gaps down.
segments.text: Step 03.18 → Step 03.20 · ~20 min · leave-state: the four-corner gap check is done, the plate's leads are dressed loose above the deck with nothing tied or terminated, and the flex plate has been test-fitted, removed and the bed covered with cardboard. Work through Checkpoint 03; the cover stays on for the next six chapters.

rows.label: Ch 04 — A/B drives and front idlers

segments.leave_state: the bench is split into four labelled kits, every part carries its destination in marker, the two inserts are in `a_drive_frame_upper`, one is in each tension arm and both M5 nuts are seated. Unplug the iron. Nothing is stacked yet.
helpers: Counts the bearings and spacers into four labelled trays, one per assembly.
Writes each destination in marker as you call it out, then reads the caliper on both lower frames.
segments.text: Step 04.1 → Step 04.5 · ~30 min · leave-state: the bench is split into four labelled kits, every part carries its destination in marker, the two inserts are in `a_drive_frame_upper`, one is in each tension arm and both M5 nuts are seated. Unplug the iron. Nothing is stacked yet.

segments.leave_state: the A (front right) idler is complete and checked against p.68: bearings flange-out, M5×40 axle in from the top and clamped firm into the arm's nut, M3×40 tensioner with its washer snug. An idler is a self-contained unit; never stop with the aid bolt withdrawn and the stack unsupported.
helpers: Pinches the two idler frames together while you swap the bolt for the arm.
Points to each circled feature on the page while you find it on the idler.
segments.text: Step 04.6 → Step 04.12 · ~40 min · leave-state: the A (front right) idler is complete and checked against p.68: bearings flange-out, M5×40 axle in from the top and clamped firm into the arm's nut, M3×40 tensioner with its washer snug. An idler is a self-contained unit; never stop with the aid bolt withdrawn and the stack unsupported.

segments.leave_state: the B (front left) idler is complete and checked against p.72, and the two idlers sit side by side with visibly different bearing heights. Both are in their trays. Nothing is open.
helpers: Pinches the two idler frames together while you swap the bolt for the arm.
Points to each circled feature on the page while you find it on the idler.
segments.text: Step 04.13 → Step 04.19 · ~35 min · leave-state: the B (front left) idler is complete and checked against p.72, and the two idlers sit side by side with visibly different bearing heights. Both are in their trays. Nothing is open.

segments.leave_state: the A drive frames are closed snug over both bearing stacks; the motor and pulley are not fitted yet. Put the closed frame in the **A DRIVE** tray; never stop with a stack loaded and the lower frame off.
helpers: Reads the eight-item stack order aloud and hands you each part in turn.
segments.text: Step 04.20 → Step 04.23 · ~25 min · leave-state: the A drive frames are closed snug over both bearing stacks; the motor and pulley are not fitted yet. Put the closed frame in the **A DRIVE** tray; never stop with a stack loaded and the lower frame off.

segments.leave_state: the A drive is finished: 2-bearing near post, 4-bearing far post, frames closed snug, pulley at 16.5 mm hub-down and threadlocked, motor in with three M3×30 and the cable exit inboard, belt path checked straight. Labelled **A — REAR RIGHT**. This is the natural stop; do not leave a bearing stack loaded with the lower frame off.
helpers: Reads the caliper aloud while you slide the pulley along the shaft.
Sights along the belt at eye level and says if it tilts.
segments.text: Step 04.24 → Step 04.28 · ~25 min · leave-state: the A drive is finished: 2-bearing near post, 4-bearing far post, frames closed snug, pulley at 16.5 mm hub-down and threadlocked, motor in with three M3×30 and the cable exit inboard, belt path checked straight. Labelled **A — REAR RIGHT**. This is the natural stop; do not leave a bearing stack loaded with the lower frame off.

segments.leave_state: the B drive is finished and labelled **B — REAR LEFT**, pulley at 6.5 mm hub-up, both cable exits facing each other when the drives are held in their build positions.
helpers: Reads the eight-item stack order aloud and hands you each part in turn.
Reads the caliper aloud and says whether the pulley is the flipped one.
Holds the A drive in its rear-right position while you hold B beside it.
Sights along the belt at eye level and says if it tilts.
segments.text: Step 04.29 → Step 04.37 · ~45 min · leave-state: the B drive is finished and labelled **B — REAR LEFT**, pulley at 6.5 mm hub-up, both cable exits facing each other when the drives are held in their build positions.

segments.leave_state: all four assemblies bagged and labelled with their destinations, and nothing left over on the bench. Work through Checkpoint 04 before Ch 05.
helpers: Writes A and B on the two bags and seals the leftover fasteners.
segments.text: Step 04.38 · ~15 min · leave-state: all four assemblies bagged and labelled with their destinations, and nothing left over on the bench. Work through Checkpoint 04 before Ch 05.

segments.leave_state: bench cleared, sub-assemblies laid out left/right, T-nuts test-rolled and counted into trays. Nothing is assembled; leave the trays covered so nothing gets swept off.
helpers: Points to each gantry part as you name it and repeats the name back.
Counts the T-nuts and bolts into their piles and checks them against the list.
segments.text: Step 05.1 → Step 05.4 · ~25 min · leave-state: bench cleared, sub-assemblies laid out left/right, T-nuts test-rolled and counted into trays. Nothing is assembled; leave the trays covered so nothing gets swept off.

segments.leave_state: XY bridge bolted to both drive units, all eight M5×10 snug, none torqued. Lay the assembly flat, motors down. Do not start a Y rail: a rail must be centred and screwed down in one sitting.
segments.text: Step 05.5 → Step 05.9 · ~30 min · leave-state: XY bridge bolted to both drive units, all eight M5×10 snug, none torqued. Lay the assembly flat, motors down. Do not start a Y rail: a rail must be centred and screwed down in one sitting.

segments.leave_state: first Y rail centred, all its M3×8 screwed down, carriage still on. Tape or stopper the carriage before you walk away.
helpers: Counts nine T-nuts into the slot and checks one sits under each marked hole.
Holds both rail jigs steady on the extrusion while you start holes 2 and 18.
segments.text: Step 05.10 → Step 05.12 · ~30 min · leave-state: first Y rail centred, all its M3×8 screwed down, carriage still on. Tape or stopper the carriage before you walk away.

segments.leave_state: both Y rails down and tightened, end M5/M3 T-nuts loaded, both carriages captive. Do not fit a backer now: start one only when you can finish it.
helpers: Checks every extrusion end: two M5 on top, one M5 and one M3 in the rail slot.
segments.text: Step 05.13 → Step 05.15 · ~30 min · leave-state: both Y rails down and tightened, end M5/M3 T-nuts loaded, both carriages captive. Do not fit a backer now: start one only when you can finish it.

segments.leave_state: both titanium Y backers screwed down flat on the rail-opposite face. Check nothing is cammed out before you stop.
helpers: Sorts the backers by length and lays each one beside the rail it matches.
Holds the backer flat on the extrusion while you start every screw.
segments.text: Step 05.16 → Step 05.18 · ~35 min · leave-state: both titanium Y backers screwed down flat on the rail-opposite face. Check nothing is cammed out before you stop.

segments.leave_state: front idlers and both Y axes bolted to the drives, gantry frame sanity-checked and deliberately left slightly loose. Do not tighten anything further; do not start an XY joint (each joint is a bearing stack you must finish in one go).
helpers: Reads the rule at the idler end while you read it at the bridge.
segments.text: Step 05.19 → Step 05.24 · ~40 min · leave-state: front idlers and both Y axes bolted to the drives, gantry frame sanity-checked and deliberately left slightly loose. Do not tighten anything further; do not start an XY joint (each joint is a bearing stack you must finish in one go).

segments.leave_state: right XY joint fully built, bolted and its 20T idler fitted and spinning. Leave the left joint's parts bagged; do not part-build it.
segments.text: Step 05.25 → Step 05.29 · ~25 min · leave-state: right XY joint fully built, bolted and its 20T idler fitted and spinning. Leave the left joint's parts bagged; do not part-build it.

segments.leave_state: both XY joints built, bolted and idler-fitted, sitting loose on the bench. Do not slide them onto the X extrusion yet.
segments.text: Step 05.30 → Step 05.31 · ~20 min · leave-state: both XY joints built, bolted and idler-fitted, sitting loose on the bench. Do not slide them onto the X extrusion yet.

segments.leave_state: MGN12 rail centred and screwed down on the X extrusion, titanium X backer on the rear face, cable-chain clearance checked. Carriage taped captive.
segments.text: Step 05.32 → Step 05.35 · ~35 min · leave-state: MGN12 rail centred and screwed down on the X extrusion, titanium X backer on the rear face, cable-chain clearance checked. Carriage taped captive.

segments.leave_state: both XY joints bolted to the X extrusion top and bottom, cable bridge on, assembly checked against p.105. Still motors-down, the way it runs. The flip is the next step — do not attempt it alone.
helpers: Counts the six M5 T-nuts aloud: four in the top slot, two underneath.
Spins each bearing stack and idler and calls out any that drags.
segments.text: Step 05.36 → Step 05.40 · ~35 min · leave-state: both XY joints bolted to the X extrusion top and bottom, cable bridge on, assembly checked against p.105. Still motors-down, the way it runs. The flip is the next step — do not attempt it alone.

segments.leave_state: gantry upside down (motors up), X axis in and bolted to both Y carriages, running end to end without binding. It stays upside down into Ch 06. Belts still bagged, XY joint bolts still only lightly tightened — leave both alone.
helpers: Holds the idler end level while you turn the gantry over.
Holds one XY joint on its carriage while you land the other.
Slides the X carriage slowly end to end and reports any rough spot.
segments.text: Step 05.41 → Step 05.44 · ~30 min · leave-state: gantry upside down (motors up), X axis in and bolted to both Y carriages, running end to end without binding. It stays upside down into Ch 06. Belts still bagged, XY joint bolts still only lightly tightened — leave both alone.

segments.leave_state: gantry complete and still upside down (motors up), measurements written down, Ch 06/07 parts bagged and labelled. Do not tension belts and do not square the gantry: both are Ch 06/07 and both would be undone.
helpers: Labels the two bags and writes what is inside each one.
Writes each gantry measurement into the log as you call it out.
segments.text: Step 05.45 → Step 05.48 · ~25 min · leave-state: gantry complete and still upside down (motors up), measurements written down, Ch 06/07 parts bagged and labelled. Do not tension belts and do not square the gantry: both are Ch 06/07 and both would be undone.

rows.label: Ch 06 Part A — Z axis: hang the gantry, Z belts

segments.leave_state: M5 nuts seated in all four Z bearing blocks, four Z belts cut to length and labelled by corner. Do not start clipping a belt end in: each corner is one continuous clip-and-clamp job.
segments.text: Step 06.1 → Step 06.4 · ~30 min · leave-state: M5 nuts seated in all four Z bearing blocks, four Z belts cut to length and labelled by corner. Do not start clipping a belt end in: each corner is one continuous clip-and-clamp job.

segments.leave_state: all four first belt ends clamped under their gantry corners with the Z bearing blocks on. Gantry still on the bench, belts hanging free — coil each tail and tape it so nothing gets stood on.
segments.text: Step 06.5 → Step 06.8 · ~40 min · leave-state: all four first belt ends clamped under their gantry corners with the Z bearing blocks on. Gantry still on the bench, belts hanging free — coil each tail and tape it so nothing gets stood on.

segments.leave_state: four lower Z joints on the Z carriages and parked at a matched height. Do not attempt the gantry lift until your second person is there: the next segment is one unbroken two-person move.
helpers: Reads the rule at all four corners and calls out any joint that sits higher.
segments.text: Step 06.9 → Step 06.10 · ~25 min · leave-state: four lower Z joints on the Z carriages and parked at a matched height. Do not attempt the gantry lift until your second person is there: the next segment is one unbroken two-person move.

segments.leave_state: gantry lifted into the frame and bolted to all four Z joints, articulating freely. This segment could not be broken (two-person lift). Z belts are still unrouted; leave the idlers alone.
helpers: Tapes the Front and Back marks, then holds one end while you turn the gantry over.
Lifts the other Y extrusion with you, hands on the extrusion only, and says stop if anything catches.
Lowers the other side in step with you and lets go only when you say so.
segments.text: Step 06.11 → Step 06.15 · ~45 min · leave-state: gantry lifted into the frame and bolted to all four Z joints, articulating freely. This segment could not be broken (two-person lift). Z belts are still unrouted; leave the idlers alone.

segments.leave_state: all four Z idlers extended, top clamps loosened, and the **first** Z belt routed, clamped at both ends, trimmed and tied. Never stop with a belt half-routed: finish the corner you are on.
helpers: Counts the turns aloud at each idler and ticks off each corner when it is done.
Pulls the belt tail tight and holds it while you tighten both M5×16 bolts.
segments.text: Step 06.16 → Step 06.21 · ~40 min · leave-state: all four Z idlers extended, top clamps loosened, and the **first** Z belt routed, clamped at both ends, trimmed and tied. Never stop with a belt half-routed: finish the corner you are on.

segments.leave_state: all four Z belts routed, clamped, trimmed and tied. Belts are hand-even but not tensioned; do not touch the A/B front-idler tension screws (Ch 07's).
segments.text: Step 06.22 · ~30 min · leave-state: all four Z belts routed, clamped, trimmed and tied. Belts are hand-even but not tensioned; do not touch the A/B front-idler tension screws (Ch 07's).

segments.leave_state: gantry squared against the A/B drives, X axis locked and released, everything moving freely by hand. Leave the machine powered off.
helpers: Plucks each Z belt in turn and says which note sounds lowest.
Watches the corner you turn and says whether it rises smoothly, with no slip.
segments.text: Step 06.23 → Step 06.25 · ~35 min · leave-state: gantry squared against the A/B drives, X axis locked and released, everything moving freely by hand. Leave the machine powered off.

segments.leave_state: Z axis mechanically complete and logged. Stop here and go to Ch 07: Part B below cannot start until Ch 13 hands off to it at Step 13.34.
